meta.name: publish
meta.description: Publish oh-my-opencode to npm by triggering the GitHub Actions publish workflow and verifying its artifacts. Ship-only: never runs pre-publish-review or re-reviews merged code unless the user explicitly asks. Argument: <patch|minor|major|explicit-semver>. Triggers: publish, release, deploy, npm publish.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 触发发布流水线,把新版本送上 npm 并逐一核验产物
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果每次发版都要手动跑工作流、还得检查构建产物是否齐全
copy.tagline_en: Trigger the publish pipeline to ship a new npm version and verify its artifacts
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you cut releases by running workflows and checking the built artifacts

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会按你给的 patch、minor、major 或明确版本号触发 GitHub Actions 发布流程,轮询到跑完,再核对 GitHub release、npm 包和 Discord 公告是否都齐。
howto.when: 当你提到 publish、release、npm publish 等关键词并要求发布时触发。必须给出 patch、minor、major 或确切版本号,没给它会先停下来问你要。

say.text: 发布一个 patch 版本
say.note: 触发发布工作流并轮询到结束

say.text: 用 5.0.0-beta.9 这个版本号发布
say.note: 指定确切版本号时会走 version 输入

say.text: 发布完成后把公告发到 Discord
say.note: 发布说明定稿后立即执行公告步骤

howto.what_en: After install, Claude triggers the GitHub Actions publish workflow for the bump or version you name, polls it to completion, then verifies the GitHub release, npm packages and Discord announcement.
howto.when_en: Fires when you mention publish, release or npm publish and ask for a release. It needs a patch, minor, major or explicit semver argument, otherwise it stops and asks you for one.

say_en.note: Triggers the publish workflow and polls it
Exact versions go through the version input

say_en.text: Post the release announcement to Discord
say_en.note: Runs right after release notes are final
